detail:
Branch lane/05-verification. Only tracked file changed: test/acceptance/oracles/C18.oracle.md (+22/-1, structured-invariants normalization, original kept verbatim as INV-1). Everything else is new. src/** untouched.

VERIFICATION RUN
- test/acceptance/harness/switchboard.test.ts — 13/13 pass; all 6 controls proven able to fail.
- test/acceptance/harness/oracles.test.ts — 156/156 pass.
- test/acceptance/slice/c16.test.ts — 12 pass / 5 todo (unchanged by this lane).
- npx tsc -p scripts/qualify/tsconfig.lane05.json — clean (the project tsconfig excludes test/ and restricts include to src/**, so lane 05's files need their own config).
- npx tsc --noEmit — clean after running scripts/inject-posthog-key.mjs. Without it there is one PRE-EXISTING error: src/analytics/_generated-posthog-key.ts is gitignored and generated by the pretest hook. Not caused by this lane.
- scripts/qualify/c28-remote end to end — 12 pass, 1 fail (A13 = F-PENDING), 21 not-tested; verify-bundle.ts independently recomputes 13 verdicts and agrees with all of them.

DEFECTS OPEN AGAINST OTHER LANES
1. F-PENDING (lane 02) — an event whose causal parent is rejected never terminates.
2. F-APPEND-GROWTH (lane 02) — append p50 ~ n^0.50; p95 crosses C28 A25's 100 ms target at ~35k events.
3. F-OFFLINE (context construction) — the MCP server path cannot disable the Hugging Face model download.
4. F-CONTROLS / F-IDS / F-CASEID (oracle corpus) — C09/C10/C11/C14/C16 have no instrument-can-fail controls and no held-out twin; six assertion-id grammars; non-uniform fixture case_id.

PROCESS NOTE WORTH KEEPING
I wrote up a sharding explanation for the append slowdown, then a 1k control contradicted it (single-shard was FASTER than spread) and I retracted the claim before it reached the report. The published finding says the mechanism is undiagnosed and names what was ruled out. Same discipline caught a false positive in my own C28 assertion: A13 initially passed because `pending_parents` carries a reason string; tightening it to require a TERMINAL refusal is what surfaced F-PENDING.

NEXT (blocked on merges)
Migration qualification (lane 02's tool), the matched benefit trial RB5, the foundation matrix and the final report. C28 on two real computers is Dave's to run.
summary: Lane 05 preparatory phase complete: 6 deliverables green, 4 defects reported (F-PENDING, F-APPEND-GROWTH, F-OFFLINE, F-CONTROLS/F-IDS); one oracle edit, no src changes
